requirement.description: The next_token function has incomplete token handling logic and returns None for partial tokens, causing parsing failures in test_multiple_comments and test_comment.

contract.description: The next_token function should correctly identify and return tokens including comments, and handle incomplete tokens appropriately. When a token is incomplete at the end of a string, it should return (start_index, end_index, None) to indicate an incomplete token rather than returning None for the entire function.

inputs.input: text: bytes - the input text to parse
i: int - starting index for parsing

outputs.output: tuple: (start_index, end_index, token_type) where token_type is either a recognized token type or None for incomplete tokens

requirement.description: The parse_obj function needs proper handling of reference parsing to correctly convert references like 6 0 R to complex numbers (e.g., 6j) as expected in test_ref and test_ref_list.

contract.description: The parse_obj function should correctly identify and convert PDF references (number 0 R) to complex number representations (e.g., 6j). This involves processing arrays and dictionaries to identify reference patterns and converting them to appropriate complex number forms.

inputs.input: text: bytes - the input text to parse
start: int - starting index for parsing (default 0)

outputs.output: parsed_object: various types - the parsed object with references converted to complex numbers

requirement.description: The replace_ref function needs to properly process references within arrays and dictionaries, ensuring it correctly handles complex number representations for references.

contract.description: The replace_ref function should process lists of tokens to identify and convert reference patterns (number 0 R) to complex number representations. It should handle both individual tokens and nested structures.

inputs.input: tokens: list - list of tokens to process

outputs.output: list: processed tokens with references converted to complex numbers

exceptions.exception: Should handle malformed reference patterns gracefully

requirement.description: The build_chrono_from_xref function has ValueError exceptions in test_index_length, test_prev, and test_page_list due to invalid literal conversions when processing PDF data.

contract.description: The build_chrono_from_xref function should correctly parse xref data without raising ValueError exceptions when converting string values to integers. It should handle cases where data might be empty or malformed.

inputs.input: bdata: bytes - the binary PDF data

exceptions.exception: Should handle empty or malformed data gracefully

requirement.description: The beginning_next_non_empty_line function references an undefined EOL variable that needs to be defined for proper line parsing.

contract.description: The beginning_next_non_empty_line function should correctly find the next non-empty line in binary data. It should define or import the EOL variable to represent end-of-line characters.

inputs.input: bdata: bytes - binary data to parse

outputs.output: int: index of the next non-empty line

exceptions.exception: Should handle cases where end of data is reached
